result:
The cleanup is done: `ai/2026/` is gone, and every Inbox card now lives in `ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/cards/`. A card's address didn't change, so old links still open it in the Inbox.

---

### Leftovers after the restart
- ✅ The old Servex wrote a few things into the old tree before it restarted (one new card folder, two re-made index pages, one prompt line). I merged them into their new copies and moved the card folder. The check found 0 bad files, and nothing was lost.
- ⚠️ I did **not** move `sessions/2026/10/14/feedback-council/`. The council script already uses the same day function as TaskDirs (`TaskDirs.dir()`). TaskDirs and the whole session store file things by the UTC day on purpose (`sessions/doc/data/layout.md`), and the folder was made at 01:00 UTC on 10-14, so it is in the right place.
- ⚠️ The one writer that uses the local day is `Cards.day_id()`. After 19:00 local, a card's day folder is one day behind that evening's tasks. Switching cards to UTC would change what the Inbox shows under "Today", so I logged it as a decision instead of changing it. The alternative, switching TaskDirs to the local day, would break the store's own rule, so I didn't take it.

---

### The task, as landed
- 664 card folders and 49 single files moved by script. Every run checked out with 0 bad files, and the undo was proven on a worktree copy first.
